title: FOOTPRINTS AND DECALS ON THE GROUND GRID
why: Job 86b step 5: in the pixel look, boot prints, water rings and decals are drawn from the 2 unit ground grid so they sit on the floor pixels like the blast scars already do.
now: With the pixel look on, footprints and ground marks line up with the floor pixels. With the look off, nothing changes.
